paite: Judahte lak ah Pathian theih in a-om a; Israelte lak ah amin athupi hi.
heading: Asaph phatna La / Vualzoupa Pathian
english: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm by Asaph. A song. In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.

paite: Salem ah biakbuk a-om a. Amah omna Zion ah a-om hi.
english: His tabernacle is also in Salem. His dwelling place in Zion.

paite: Huai ah thalpeu thalte ahihsia a; phawte, namsaute, kidouna vanzatte toh. Selah
english: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.

paite: Nang thupitak leh hoihtak na hi a, sathah tangte sang in.
english: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.

paite: Lungtang phate'n suam atuak ua, a-ihmu uh a-ihmu denta uhi; mihatte leng kuamah in akhut uh alik theita kei uhi.
english: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.

paite: Jakob' Pathian aw, na sawina ziak in kangtalai leh sakol leng gen ding thei lou in a-om tuaktuak uhi.
english: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

paite: Nang, nangmah mah, lau ding na hi; na heh peuhmah leh, kua ahia na mitmuh a dingh thei ding?
english: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?

paite: Na vaihawm thu van a kipan in na theisak a; lei alau a, adaita hi.
english: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,

paite: Lei a mi thunuailut tengteng hondam ding leh vaihawm ding a Pathian athoh lai in. Selah
english: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.

paite: Pel lou in mihing hehna in nang ahon phat ding a, hehna kawnggak in na kigak ding hi.
english: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.

paite: Thu chiam inla, TOUPA na Pathian uh lak ah hihtangtung un; akim a mi tengteng in kihtak dingpa kipahmante hon tawisak uhen.
english: Make vows to Yahweh your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.

paite: Ama'n lalte kha asatkhe ding a; amah lei a kumpipate a ding in akihtakhuai ahi.
english: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.
